product_family: ContentBot.ai is an AI-powered content automation platform offering blog post generation, marketing copy creation, landing page builders, workflow automation (Flows), bulk importing, and content humanization tools. Supports 110+ languages and serves digital marketers, content creators, SEO specialists, and agencies.

certifications.name: SOC 2 (Type 1 or Type 2)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of SOC 2 certification found on ContentBot.ai website, privacy policy, or terms of service.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO 27001 certification found in reviewed documentation.

certifications.name: GDPR Compliance
certifications.proof_quote: Privacy policy states 'Code Cabin and ContentBot.ai support the spirit and aim of data protection proposed by the GDPR' and 'will process this data in adherence to the GDPR', but no formal GDPR certification (binding corporate rules, standard contractual clauses, or adequacy decision) is documented.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: No evidence of HIPAA applicability or compliance; ContentBot.ai is a consumer/commercial content generation tool with no healthcare-specific features or claims.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Payment processing handled by Stripe and PayPal (PCI-compliant third parties), but no direct PCI DSS certification for ContentBot.ai itself.

certifications.name: ISO 27017 / ISO 27018 (Cloud Security)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of cloud security certifications.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of AI governance certification; company mentions 'ethical AI program' worked on with OpenAI, but no formal ISO 42001 certification provided.

certifications.name: CSA STAR AI
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of Cloud Security Alliance STAR AI certification.

privacy.ai_training_note: Terms of Service grant ContentBot 'a non-exclusive, transferable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid-up license' to User Content. This language is ambiguous regarding AI model training. Privacy policy does not explicitly disclose whether customer content is used to train or improve AI models. No clear opt-out mechanism for AI training is documented.
privacy.data_region: United States (Miami, Florida) and South Africa (Boksburg, Gauteng). Data stored on Code Cabin servers.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: No explicit details provided; privacy policy states 'reasonable steps' to protect personal information.

security.name: Data Storage
security.value: Stored on Code Cabin servers. Support data stored on internal support desk with access limited to support agents subject to confidentiality agreements.

security.name: Breach Notification
security.value: Notification within 72 hours of discovery and without undue delay, in accordance with GDPR.

security.name: Payment Security
security.value: Uses GDPR-compliant third-party processors (Stripe and PayPal) with strict data protection measures.

security.name: Third-Party Audit / Penetration Testing
security.value: No public evidence of regular security audits or penetration testing.

security.name: Employee Security Training
security.value: No documentation of employee security training or data handling policies.

products.name: AI Blog Writer v4.0
products.data_scope: Processes blog topics and user inputs to generate full blog posts. User content licensed to ContentBot under broad terms.
products.notes: Includes SEO optimization, intelligent linking, and uniqueness scoring. Supports 110+ languages.

products.name: AI Flows
products.data_scope: Automates content workflows with triggers, actions, and filters. Can process bulk data and schedules (daily/weekly).
products.notes: Supports complex content strategies; Premium+ tier allows unlimited workflows.

products.name: Importer
products.data_scope: Uploads bulk data (CSV/documents) for batch AI processing. Outputs returned as CSV, documents, or email.
products.notes: Premium tier: 50 row limit; Premium+ tier: 500 row limit. Processes large datasets.

products.name: AI Content Humanizer
products.data_scope: Processes AI-generated content to produce 'undetectable' human-like output. Bypasses detection tools (ZeroGPT, Winston AI).
products.notes: Marketed for stealth/evasion; raises ethical and detection-avoidance concerns.

products.name: Landing Page Generator
products.data_scope: Generates landing page copy from user input.

products.name: AI Chat
products.data_scope: Real-time conversational interface; processes user queries and context.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium + subscription tiers: Starter ($9/mo, 50k words), Premium ($29/mo, 150k words), Premium+ ($49/mo, 400k words). Prepaid per-word option ($0.5 per 1000 words). 10k free words on first purchase.
compare.data_residency: Not fully disclosed; data stored on Code Cabin servers in US (Miami) and South Africa (Boksburg). No explicit data residency guarantees or GDPR-compliant data localization options documented.

flags: NO_FORMAL_CERTIFICATIONS: ContentBot.ai has zero publicly documented certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, etc.). Privacy policy emphasizes GDPR principles but lacks formal compliance frameworks or third-party verification.

AMBIGUOUS_DATA_TRAINING: Terms of Service grant broad 'non-exclusive, transferable' license to User Content, but privacy policy does not explicitly disclose AI training practices. No clear customer opt-out mechanism for model training.
NO_DPA: No standalone Data Processing Agreement (DPA) found; users relying on broad Terms + Privacy policy for compliance.
NO_TRUST_CENTER: No dedicated trust/security center, transparency portal, or compliance documentation published.

EVASION_TOOL_MARKETING: 'AI Content Humanizer' is marketed as bypassing detection tools (ZeroGPT, Winston AI) and enabling 'undetectable AI content' and 'stealth mode.' This raises ethical and use-case concerns (potential academic dishonesty, plagiarism detection evasion).
NO_SECURITY_AUDITS: No evidence of third-party security audits, penetration testing, or ongoing compliance monitoring.

GROWTH_STAGE_POSTURE: 7-person team, recently founded (early 2021), no formal security/compliance infrastructure evident. This is typical for growth-stage startups but indicates lower maturity than enterprise vendors.
GDPR_UNVERIFIED: While privacy policy claims GDPR adherence, the claims are not backed by legal documentation, audit reports, or formal compliance certification. Liability and enforceability unclear.
